**HMG-API 1.1.0-rc.5 is the fifth release candidate.** It brings hook maps for many more cars (most of the older Hyundai models on their newest software among them), car events and Home Wi-Fi for mods, and wireless CarPlay + Android Auto 2.2.0-rc.6. 1.1.0 will be this code unless a blocker turns up. **This RC hasn't been checked on a car yet**, so please report how it goes. If you'd rather wait, stay on [1.0.2](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/releases/tag/v1.0.2): it's still the current release.

It comes with **Wireless CarPlay + Android Auto [2.2.0-rc.6](https://github.com/Open-HMG/hmgapi-wireless-cp-aa/releases/tag/v2.2.0-rc.6)** and **ADB [1.0.1-rc.1](https://github.com/Open-HMG/hmgapi-adb/releases/tag/v1.0.1-rc.1)**. NEMESIS in the app menu is the same as in rc.4.

## What's new since 1.1.0-rc.4

- **More cars' hook maps:**

  | Region | Cars |
  |---|---|
  | USA and Canada, 260903 | Elantra (and Hybrid), Sonata (and Hybrid), Santa Fe (and Hybrid, Plug-in Hybrid), Kona, Kona Electric 2020-21, Ioniq (Electric, Hybrid, Plug-in Hybrid), Venue 2020-22, Veloster N, Palisade 2020-22: every hook point, from the stock files (#320) |
  | USA | Ioniq 6 on 260206 (same software as the Canadian one) |
  | Korea | Avante (`CN7`, and the facelifted `CN7PE`), Ioniq 6 |
  | India | Kia EV6 (thanks to codevalley), Creta Electric |

- **The Canadian Ioniq 6 260206 map** has no points matched by name only now: a Car Report from a US Ioniq 6 with the same software confirmed them.
- **Car events for mods:** a mod can ask to hear when the car is parked (the driver got out), switched on again, about to shut down, or back from QuickBoot, and tidy up then. Settings → Vehicle → **When the car is parked** sets what "parked" means.
- **Home Wi-Fi while the car is off** (new switch, off by default: HMG-API app → Settings → Home Wi-Fi). When the car has been off for 30 s or is parked, the car joins your home Wi-Fi instead of running its hotspot, and switches back the moment you start the car. Only HMG-API and the mods that ask use it; the car's own services stay on mobile data. Tried on a US EV6.
- **Mods never use the car's mobile data**, DNS included. Their internet is home Wi-Fi only, unless you allow one mod (`overrides.allow_cellular`, with a warning). **This changes mods that used mobile data until now.**
- **Wireless on the older Hyundai and Kia builds:** the projection hotspot comes up with the name and key the phone is told, so the phone can join it (#159).
- **A swapped voice button no longer starts the car's voice assistant by itself** minutes later (thanks to sirishant, #301).
- **The `parked` reading works without a mod asking for car events.**
- **New Car Reports sort themselves:** a report for a build with a tracker goes into it, a new build's report becomes its tracker, and software older than 2026 gets the "update first" answer.
- **Three more mods in the catalogue:** Gen5W Button Mapper and Gen5W Split Screen Blocker (DeFlight, LLC), and Comfort & Startup 1.1.8 (lemoyneiv).
- **Wireless 2.2.0-rc.6** brings the older Hyundai models above, with their stock wireless CarPlay and Android Auto and HMG-API's hotspot (their Car Reports said Wi-Fi "unpowered", and **Install anyway** couldn't help), and the Ioniq 5 on Canada 260903. See [its notes](https://github.com/Open-HMG/hmgapi-wireless-cp-aa/releases/tag/v2.2.0-rc.6).
- The full list is in the [CHANGELOG](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/blob/v1.1.0-rc.5/CHANGELOG.md).

## Car Reports wanted

**From the older Hyundai models (any of the ones above, 260507, 260206 or 260903):** a Car Report after trying wireless CarPlay or Android Auto. Did the car's Wi-Fi come up? Nobody has run wireless on these cars yet.

These builds' maps still have a few points matched by name only. **One Car Report from this RC per row confirms them**, for every model in the row:

| Build | Any one of these |
|---|---|
| Hyundai Palisade, US 260903 | Palisade 2023 and on |
| Genesis G70 | USA 260507 or Korea 260902 |
| Kia, Korea 260902 | EV6, K3 |
| Hyundai, India 260430 | Creta |
| Hyundai Ioniq 6, Korea 260902 | Ioniq 6 |

A Car Report from this RC also maps the newest points (Phone Projection's service, the hotspot's settings) on every map that was made from a Car Report.

These have **no map yet**: the **Palisade 2023 on US 260507** (in review), the **Kona Electric on Canada 260206**, and the **Elantra N 2022-23, Kona Electric 2022-23 and Venue 2023 on 260903**. A Car Report from this RC is all it takes.

A **Check the map on this car** (HMG-API app → Settings) helps too, from any car whose map says "waiting for a check on a car". More in [#247](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/issues/247).

## Installing

- **From 1.0.x, the beta or an earlier RC:** put `hmgapi-1.1.0-rc.5-update.zip` in `HMGAPI/updates/` on a USB stick, then HMG-API app → **Check USB updates**. Restart the head unit once afterwards. Your mods and settings stay. To update the wireless mod too, also put `wireless-carplay-aa-2.2.0-rc.6.zip` in `HMGAPI/updates/`, pick it in Check USB updates, and **Apply changes**.
- **With NEMESIS:** unzip `hmgapi-1.1.0-rc.5-nemesis.zip` onto a stick and update from NEMESIS Manager's Package Store.
- **New install, or after a firmware update:** follow [Installing HMG-API](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/wiki/Installing-HMG-API), with `hmgapi-1.1.0-rc.5-usb.zip`.

## What to test

- **After updating:** the app shows **1.1.0-rc.5** and "Hooks on" on a car that had them, and your mods still run after a restart.
- **A mod that used the internet** (weather, updates): does it still work on home Wi-Fi, and does it say so when there's none?
- **Home Wi-Fi:** turn it on, add your network, park at home and switch off. After about 30 s the car should join it, and starting the car should bring the hotspot and wireless projection back.
- **Wireless CarPlay and Android Auto** on a car where they worked with rc.4: music, a call, turn-by-turn on the cluster.
- **An older Hyundai model:** wireless, as above, then a [Car Report](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/wiki/Car-Report).
- **A car in the new list:** HMG-API app → Settings → **Check the map on this car**, restart, then make a Car Report.

## Known issues

- Bluetooth Audio can take audio focus at a cold start before CarPlay or Android Auto is up. A fix is in review (wireless #56).
- The rest are the same as in [1.0.0](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/releases/tag/v1.0.0). For example, a USB stick left in the port can start wired Android Auto and stop wireless from connecting, so take the stick out after installing.

## Going back

- **To 1.1.0-rc.4 with adb:** `adb push hmgapi-1.1.0-rc.4-update.zip /data/local/tmp/`, then `adb shell hmgapid engine update-hmgapi /data/local/tmp/hmgapi-1.1.0-rc.4-update.zip --force`. Restart the head unit.
- **To 1.0.2:** as in [rc.3's notes](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/releases/tag/v1.1.0-rc.3#going-back-to-102). Wireless 2.2.0-rc.6 needs HMG-API 1.1.0-rc.3 or newer, so going back to 1.0.2 means going back to wireless 2.1.0 too.

## Reporting

Open an [issue](https://github.com/Open-HMG/HMG-API/issues/new/choose) with your car, its head unit software (e.g. 260507), the HMG-API version and your mods, and a Car Report if you can.
